metadata.document: SUBMISSION ON DISCUSSION DOCUMENT “FRESHWATER FARM PLAN REGULATIONS”
metadata.organisation: Choose Clean Water, Environmental Defence Society Inc, Fish and Game Council, Greenpeace Aotearoa, Royal Forest and Bird Protection Society of New Zealand

cleaned_body_text: This is a submission on the discussion document “Freshwater farm plan regulations”, Publication Number ME 1577. The Discussion Document seeks feedback on the regulations needed to give effect to the freshwater farm plan process set out in Part 9A of the Resource Management Act 1991. The submitters include the Environmental Defence Society, Greenpeace Aotearoa, Fish and Game Council, and the Royal Forest and Bird Protection Society of New Zealand. The state of freshwater in Aotearoa New Zealand is well documented, with native species and ecosystems under threat and water polluted in most urban, farming, and forestry areas. The submission addresses the history of farm planning, the content of freshwater farm plans including regulated outcomes and base information, risk and impact assessments, certification and audit processes, transparency, enforcement, and the phasing and staging of the roll-out.
